body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Part type on the page is an S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit. Unit: set. φ105 appears only as a small-end kit on this page. Material is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The S-tube seal page does not point to Electric 20, HBT8018, LZ-60 or any other model slug. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write S-tube small-end seal, φ105, and the quantity in sets. For φ220, say whether the six-piece kit is the row you checked on the machine. For other large-end sizes, do not add a six-piece count. The outline does not complete a blank.
